exposure: qualitative abnormal umbilical artery Doppler waveforms (Abnormal UA) during the early second trimester
location of abnormality (free-loop vs. placental cord insertion site)
type of abnormal UA (Type I: positive diastolic, Type II: persistent Abnormal UA, Type III: intermittent Abnormal UA)
outcome: prevalence of abnormal umbilical artery Doppler waveforms
cohort: The study included 153 monochorionic diamniotic (MCDA) twin pregnancies.
finding: A quarter (25%) of MCDA twin pregnancies showed abnormal umbilical artery Doppler waveforms between 16 and 17 weeks' gestation, with 63-79% of these cases subsequently normalizing.
